items.title: Chuck Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 7, 2023
items.q: he would turn us on to stuff, you know Pharoah Sanders, McCoy and all this stuff

ctx.x: He was one of the first guys I heard jazz-wise. The drummer I was referring to back in the early days that my brother John brought down from Columbia was a super audiophile dude and he would turn us on to stuff, you know Pharoah Sanders, McCoy and all this stuff. But I had been playing piano for maybe a year but it was happening pretty quickly for me and I remember I was at the piano doing stuff and Jon Margolis, he’s the drummer from Dry Jack, right, he had a reel to reel tape recorder and he came up with these…

Same here. Of course I had the Desmond — you know being a saxophone player Paul Desmond like — oh, something about it really grabbed me and you I guess. So what can you tell us about Dave Brubeck that really struck you?
